Dread Reflection

You spread your arms, and your outline twists into something your enemy dreads. They recoil as the vision presses against their thoughts.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Guile

Target / range / shape: One visible creature within 5 squares

Proposed NPC defense attribute: Reason.

- Weak: 3 mental damage. - Standard: 3 mental damage; Frightened 1 of you. - Strong: 5 mental damage; Frightened 2 of you.

Duration: Instant

Equipment / acquisition: None.

---

Tier / minimum level: 3 · DP: 4 · Requirements to learn: Mind 2

Type: Magic / Attack

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: dread-reflection
